📖 CSC Rate List Kaise Banayein — Step by Step Guide

SmartCSCTools.org ke is free AI tool se apne CSC Center ya Cyber Cafe ki professional rate list banayein — sirf 5 minutes mein!

01
🖼️

Template Select Karein

Right side mein 5 professional CSC templates dikhe hain. Kisi bhi template ki image pe click karo — full size preview khulega. Apni pasand ka template "Select" button se chunein.

💡 Template select karte hi form left side pe khul jayega
02
🏪

Center Details Bharo

Form ke Center Tab mein apna CSC Center naam, VLE naam, shop address, mobile number, WhatsApp, email aur state select karein. Tagline bhi add kar sakte hain.

💡 * starred fields required hain
03
🖨️

Printing Rates Bharo

Printing Tab mein B&W printing rates, color printing rates aur passport size photo rates bharo. Default rates pehle se fill hain — sirf edit karein.

💡 "+" button se naye rows add karein, "×" se delete karein
04
🌐

Online Services Rates

Online Tab mein sabhi online services (Aay/Jati/Niwas, PAN, Ration Card, Voter ID, Aadhar etc.) ki rates aur bijli bill payment charges bharo.

💡 Jitni chahein utni services add kar sakte hain
05
🪪

Aadhar & Other Services

Aadhar Tab mein Aadhar print, PVC card services add karein. Other Tab mein miscellaneous services, banking charges aur GST notice text bharo.

💡 GST notice default mein already filled hai
06
🚀

Generate & Download

"Generate Rate List with ChatGPT" button dabao — prompt copy hoga, ChatGPT.com new tab mein khulega. Wahan Ctrl+V karke Enter dabao — rate list ready!

💡 Rate list image right-click → "Save Image As" se save karein

❓ Aksar Puche Jane Wale Sawaal (FAQ)

CSC Rate List Generator ke baare mein sabse zyada puche jaane wale sawaal aur unke jawab

CSC Service Rate List Generator kya hai?▼
SmartCSCTools.org ka CSC Rate List Generator ek free AI-powered online tool hai. Isse aap apne CSC Center (Common Service Centre), Cyber Cafe, Jan Seva Kendra, E-Mitra ya kisi bhi digital service center ki professional rate list banane ke liye ChatGPT prompt automatically generate kar sakte hain. Koi design skill ya software ki zaroorat nahi hai.
CSC Rate List banane mein kitna time lagta hai?▼
Sirf 3–5 minute! Template select karein, details bharo, Generate button dabao, ChatGPT mein paste karo — bas itna kaafi hai. ChatGPT kuch seconds mein aapki complete professional rate list bana deta hai.
Kya yeh tool bilkul free hai?▼
Haan, SmartCSCTools.org ka CSC Rate List Generator 100% free hai. Koi registration, login ya payment nahi chahiye. Bas form bharo aur rate list banao — koi hidden charges nahi.
Kya ChatGPT account zaroor chahiye?▼
Haan, ChatGPT.com par ek free account banana hoga. Generate button click karne ke baad ChatGPT apne aap new tab mein khul jayega. Phir Ctrl+V se prompt paste karke Enter dabao.
Rate list Hindi mein ban sakti hai?▼
Bilkul haan! Sabhi 5 templates Hindi mein designed hain. Form mein "Bhasha" dropdown se Hindi, Hindi+English (Mixed) ya English Only select kar sakte hain. Default option Hindi hai.
Rate list print kaise karein?▼
ChatGPT se banai hui rate list image ko right-click → "Save Image As" se save karein. Phir kisi bhi photo print shop pe le jaayein ya local flex printer se A3 banner ya A4 size mein print karwayein.
Naye services add kaise karein?▼
Har section ke neeche "+ सेवा जोड़ें" (Add Service) button hai. Uspe click karo — ek naya empty row aa jayega jisme tum naya service naam aur rate type kar sakte ho. Row delete karne ke liye "×" button dabao.
Apna khud ka design kaise use karein?▼
Template list mein sabse neeche "✨ Custom / Apna Design" option select karein. Form bharo, Generate karein, ChatGPT mein prompt paste karne ke baad apni reference rate list ki image bhi 📎 attach icon se upload karein — ChatGPT wahi design use karke naya rate list banayega.
